resources.string: Policy: All sectors/bits are treated as UNHEALTHY unless verified healthy by a completed scan. If the phone powers off/restarts during a scan, the in-progress sector/bit is marked PERMANENTLY UNUSABLE and is never rescanned. The app keeps a persistent healthy/bad sector map. Manual scan control only. Note: Android apps cannot force other apps to use specific physical sectors; OS/filesystem-level enforcement requires root/system support. Raw block scans require root.
